description.value: The Museum of Archaeology & Ethnology at Simon Fraser University is a free-admission research museum whose collections span British Columbia and the wider world, with a strong emphasis on decolonised, community-based practice and Indigenous partnerships. It functions as an active scholarly hub where faculty and student research intersects with public exhibits and archives. Touring cyclists looking for a thought-provoking cultural stop on the SFU Burnaby campus will find an intellectually engaged space that charges no entry fee.

The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the museum is clearly on SFU's Burnaby campus — a data error to flag. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all required and optional amenity fields are null.
